method.mode: external-process paired alternating cache-disabled/warm-cache after one warmup
method.scenario: branch_pr task with a dirty implementation worktree and complete AgentWorkOrder preparation
method.baseline: The same candidate build with AGENTPLANE_PREPARATION_CACHE=0.
method.candidate: An exact persistent Git snapshot cache under the Git common directory.
method.functional_comparison: Exact stdout equality for the cold miss, first warm run, and every paired run.
candidate_key: SHA-256 of exact Git index bytes

threshold.reason: A persistent cache with invalidation, corruption, locking, and retention machinery must save at least five percent end to end; smaller gains do not justify the new state surface.

command_local_task_snapshot_experiment.method: Fifteen alternating external-process pairs against the RF-26a binary, with persistent cache disabled in both builds.

candidate_selection.reason: The exact live pre-key repeats most of the expensive untracked-file scan, leaving only a 3.94 percent end-to-end warm gain.
Complete invalidation requires the source task plus every dependency and backend projection; the measured node cost does not cover that state surface.
Branch snapshot discovery remains the dominant pre-key cost, while command-local coalescing improved the full command by only 1.18 percent.
TTL reuse can serve stale hosted authority. Route and side-effect truth remain live even though the provider node is expensive.
The node is semantic authority state and requires live revalidation.

decision.reason: The measured benefit fails the declared complexity threshold, while the cold path becomes slower and the cache adds a new persistent concurrency surface.
decision.recommended_follow_up: Benchmark parallel observation of independent Git root, HEAD, status, and index inputs without persistent state.
